profile.headline: Software Engineer Specializing in Health Care Interoperability
profile.summary: Experienced Senior Software Engineer with a demonstrated history of working in the information technology and services industry. Strong engineering professional skilled in Spring Boot, Groovy, Intellij, Jenkins pipelines.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Develop B2B backend APIs for high volume medical record discovery and exchange product (Record Locator & Exchange) in Groovy, Spring, and Apache Camel using IHE(HL7) and FHIR messaging standards.
Develop internal micro-services (Groovy/Spring Boot) to support larger external facing applications.
Contribute to internal build and deployment infrastructure (Jenkins 2 Pipelines)
Guide Technical direction of the product as the teams Technical Lead
Handle and coordinate cross team dependencies and and infrastructure initiatives. 
Software Development using Agile.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Develop B2B backend APIs for high volume medical record discovery and exchange product (Record Locator & Exchange) in Groovy, Spring, and Apache Camel using IHE(HL7) and FHIR messaging standards.
Build applications using Clojure for large Formulary Benefit file ingestion.
Manage legacy B2B API application for Medication History and Pharmacy Benefit Manager (PBM) Eligibility Transactions.

positions.title: Programmer / Analyst
positions.description: I worked on the Data Warehouse Analytics team to program Clinical Quality Measures and other metrics for reporting to both internal and external entities. I also build and maintain dashboards for reporting data pertaining to clinic initiatives and other quality measures.
